obligations.statement: The product must be a storage container that can contain items.
derivation_premises: A container must have an interior volume to store items.

obligations.statement: The product must be compact and suitable for a desktop.
derivation_premises: Desktop suitability imposes size constraints that depend on the mechanism.

obligations.statement: The product must have a latch that can be engaged and disengaged.
derivation_premises: A latch must be operable to open and close.

obligations.statement: The latch must be reusable, meaning it must withstand repeated open-close cycles.
derivation_premises: Repeated operation induces wear that depends on material and mechanism.

obligations.statement: The box must not open accidentally during normal handling.
derivation_premises: Accidental opening occurs under loads that must be reacted to keep the latch closed.

obligations.statement: The latch must be easy for a user to operate.
derivation_premises: Effort and reachability depend on mechanism and geometry.

obligations.statement: The lid or closing element must remain secure during transport.
derivation_premises: Transport loads must be reacted to prevent opening.

obligations.statement: The product must be suitable for low-cost manufacturing.
derivation_premises: Cost depends on manufacturing process and material.

obligations.statement: The design must be mechanically plausible.
derivation_premises: A mechanism must have the necessary degrees of freedom to function.

obligations.statement: The product must be easy to assemble.
derivation_premises: Assembly requires that parts can be placed without interference.

load_cases.reacted_at_role: the surface the product stands on

candidates.summary: Box with a latch using a friction hold and a compliant flexure for reuse.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Friction retention requires contact analysis; route not available.

candidates.summary: Box with a latch using an over-centre mechanism for secure closure.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Ideal joint analysis can verify over-centre behaviour.

candidates.summary: Box with a latch using a detent or snap fit for simplicity.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Snap action requires compliance analysis; route not available.
